Newport Asia Has Trimmed Its Baidu (BIDU) Holding by $8.82 Million as Share Value Declined; As Microsoft Com (MSFT) Stock Price Declined, Holder Cedar Hill Associates Lifted Position Posted by William Moore on January 13, 2019 at 9:20 pm
Cedar Hill Associates Llc increased its stake in Microsoft Corp Com (MSFT) by 88.08% based on its latest 2018Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Cedar Hill Associates Llc bought 15,147 shares as the company’s stock declined 1.64% with the market. The hedge fund held 32,344 shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2018Q3, valued at $3.70M, up from 17,197 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Cedar Hill Associates Llc who had been investing in Microsoft Corp Com for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $789.25B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.77% or $0.8 during the last trading session, reaching $102.8. About 28.31 million shares traded. Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) has risen 30.43% since January 13, 2018 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 30.43% the S&P500. Newport Asia Llc decreased its stake in Baidu Inc (BIDU) by 22.75% based on its latest 2018Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Newport Asia Llc sold 38,700 shares as the company’s stock declined 16.10% with the market. The institutional investor held 131,400 shares of the technology company at the end of 2018Q3, valued at $30.05M, down from 170,100 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Newport Asia Llc who had been investing in Baidu Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $57.90 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.33% or $2.24 during the last trading session, reaching $166.11. About 2.34M shares traded. Baidu, Inc. (NASDAQ:BIDU) has declined 23.09% since January 13, 2018 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 23.09% the S&P500.
